items.reason: Describes a plantain-like cooking fruit, strongly associated with banana; only generic fruit context connects it to cantaloupe.

Pressure-gauge calibration is unrelated to either fruit.
Mashed fruit used to sweeten porridge plausibly refers to banana, but the use is not exclusive to it; cantaloupe shares only generic fruit context.
Using chopped, water-rich stalks as mulch strongly suggests banana plant material; the crop-growing context is only weakly related to cantaloupe.
Starch from unripe fruit plausibly refers to banana, but the description is not exclusive; its cantaloupe connection is generic fruit context.
A whole portable piece of produce strongly suggests a banana; cantaloupe is connected only through the general produce context.
PLU code 4011 distinctively identifies bananas, though it is not a name or alias; cantaloupe shares only generic produce context.
A creamy fruit puree in a cocktail plausibly suggests banana but is not exclusive; cantaloupe has only a generic fruit connection.
The edible berry-like portion and elongated form distinctively describe banana; the contrast with a spherical form is explainably related to cantaloupe's shape, but is not a Y-specific fact.
Tiny undeveloped seeds in creamy pulp strongly suggest banana; the connection to cantaloupe is limited to general fruit anatomy.
A folded paper map is unrelated to either fruit.
